name: Daniel
label: Apple Music switcher weighing Spotify
who: I have switched between Apple Music and Spotify several times, and my devices range from Apple gear to Android. I care most about sound quality, a clean interface, and recommendations that surface music I have not heard before.
value_for_money: Several posts call Apple Music the better deal, citing lossless audio, Spatial Audio and Apple One bundling, while others say Spotify is cheaper or offers more content. The evidence is mixed and does not settle which is better value.
loyalty: Spotify Connect, wide device support including Android Auto, and social features keep some users returning. Apple Music's lossless audio, interface and recommendations pull them away, and Spotify's UI changes and podcast push are the reasons they give for leaving.
pain_points: Podcasts pushed on the home screen
No lossless or Spatial Audio on Spotify
Library navigation for saved artists and albums
likes: Apple Music sound quality and lossless audio
reasons_to_stay: Several users say Spotify's Connect, cross-platform support and Android Auto keep them there even when they prefer Apple Music's sound. Others value Spotify's playlists, crossfade and social features, and one finds it easier to discover new artists there.
tone: Measured and comparative, weighing pros and cons in lists and reasons, with the occasional wry remark.
